inputs.prompt:
Create one isolated source asset for a character model sheet. Preserve the same subject and apparent age shown in the original references; do not redesign or beautify the face. Preserve original rendering style, hairstyle, outfit, colors, accessories, proportions and natural asymmetry. Originals outrank generated guides for identity. Pure uniform white background, natural shading on the subject, no floor plane or background cast shadow, no added labels, borders, rulers or watermark. Preserve existing garment lettering, patterns and worn accessories. Infer only minimal coherent hidden construction.
Image 1 is the original reference and defines identity.
Create one full-body FRONT view. Upright relaxed turnaround pose, arms slightly away from torso, entire head/hair/accessories and soles visible. Centered orthographic-like presentation. Preserve reference head-to-torso proportions without normalizing stylized anatomy. White background.
inputs.negative_prompt: added text, ruler, grid, border, watermark, background scenery, floor shadow, cropped requested feature, duplicate subject, extra limbs, distorted proportions, blurry details
